Job Description

You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery.

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
- Build automated test suites across:
- UI (Web/Mobile)
- API and integration layers
- Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
- Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
- Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
- Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
- Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
- Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
- Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
- Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
- Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
- Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
- Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

- Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
- Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
- Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
- Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
- Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
- Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
- Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
- Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
- Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
- Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
- Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
- Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
- Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
- Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field
- 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
- Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
- Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
- Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
- Experience with:
- API testing (REST, Postman, etc.)
- Version control (Git)
- CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
- Familiarity with:
- Test data management
- Test reporting and logging tools
- Debugging and root cause analysis

Assets

- Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
- Exposure to:
- Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
- DevSecOps practices
- Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e.g., GitHub Copilot)

- Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
- Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
- Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
- Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.

Job Description

The Role

insightsoftware is a global provider of comprehensive solutions for the Office of the CFO. As a Software Development Engineer in Test 2 on the Certent Disclosure Management (CDM) team, you'll be an engineer first. You'll work inside the codebase alongside developers to make CDM testable at every level, pushing coverage down the test pyramid so that most quality is proven by fast, reliable unit, component, and integration tests rather than slow end-to-end suites. Working closely with development and DevOps, you'll help ensure CDM ships reliable, high-quality releases to enterprise customers.

What You Will Do

- Refactor production C# code to improve testability: introduce dependency injection, create seams, decouple components, and remove hard-coded dependencies.
- Write characterization tests to safely bring legacy code under test before changing it.
- Pair with developers on design and on unit, component, and integration test strategy, and help them write better tests themselves.
- Use AI coding agents to write and refactor tests and production code. Own the agent rule files and tooling that govern how they write tests (e.g., AGENTS.md, MCP servers).
- Define and evolve the team's test architecture, deciding what belongs at each level of the pyramid and actively shrinking reliance on E2E tests.
- Review PRs, including agent-generated changes, for testability, test quality, and coverage, not just for whether tests exist.
- Review requirements and acceptance criteria early to shape testable designs.
- Build and maintain quality gates in CI pipelines (test stages, coverage, reporting, flaky-test detection).
- Develop reusable test libraries, fixtures, and test data builders in C#.
- Maintain a lean, targeted set of E2E and UI tests (Selenium, Ranorex) for critical user journeys across web and desktop.
- Contribute to API and performance testing.
- Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

What You Bring

Core Skills

- Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, with experience writing and refactoring production code, not only test code.
- Deep experience with unit testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest) and mocking libraries (Moq, NSubstitute, or similar).
- Solid understanding of dependency injection, SOLID principles, and techniques for breaking dependencies in legacy code.
- Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot agent mode, Cursor), the judgment to spot weak or incorrect agent output, and the ability to teach others to do the same.
- Experience writing integration and component tests (e.g., WebApplicationFactory, Testcontainers, in-memory or containerized databases).
- A clear point of view on the test pyramid and when each type of test is the right tool.
- Experience with CI/CD and source control (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, Bitbucket).
- Working experience with UI automation (Selenium, Ranorex, or similar).
- Experience in Agile Scrum/Kanban teams.

Nice to Have

- TDD experience.
- BDD experience (e.g., Reqnroll, SpecFlow, Gherkin).
- Contract testing (e.g., Pact), mutation testing (e.g., Stryker.NET), coverage tooling (e.g., Coverlet).
- Performance or load testing experience.
- Experience in financial reporting or other regulated domains.

Experience

- 4+ years of software development experience, including writing and refactoring production C# code.
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

This person should be able to identify risks, design comprehensive test strategies, and build reliable automation with minimal oversight.

This is an engineering-focused quality role. It requires building test frameworks, investigating complex system behavior, and improving quality throughout the development lifecycle—not primarily manual test execution.

Here's a closer look at this key role:

- Define and own test strategies for distributed services and data-processing systems.

- Design performance, scalability, endurance, and capacity tests.
- Conduct fault-injection and resilience testing for service, network, storage, and infrastructure failures.
- Validate rolling upgrades, backward compatibility, schema evolution, and data migrations.
- Test concurrency, race conditions, partitioning, and workload-skew scenarios.
- Create deterministic test datasets and production-representative workloads.
- Establish quality gates and automated checks within CI/CD pipelines.
- Improve defect detection through observability, logs, metrics, tracing, and data reconciliation.
- Investigate production issues and convert them into durable regression tests.
- Review technical designs for testability, reliability, and operational risk.
- Partner with developers, data engineers, ML engineers, and infrastructure teams.
- Mentor engineers and promote shared ownership of quality

What you'll need :

- Strong experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, QA Automation Engineer, or Quality Engineer testing production backend, distributed, cloud, or data-platform systems.
- Strong proficiency in Python, Java, TypeScript, or another general-purpose programming language, with the ability to build production-quality test infrastructure.
- Experience designing and building test automation frameworks from the ground up, rather than relying exclusively on record/playback or UI-centric testing tools.
- Hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks and libraries such as pytest, Playwright, REST Assured, Karate, Pact, Testcontainers, WireMock, k6, Locust, Gatling, or equivalent.
- Experience testing Kafka or comparable event-streaming/message-broker technologies.
- Strong experience with API and service-level automation, including REST, WebSocket, gRPC, streaming APIs, and asynchronous APIs where applicable.
- Experience validating databases, caches, messaging systems, search platforms, and data pipelines rather than validating only API responses.
- Experience with Testcontainers, Docker Compose, Kubernetes-based test environments, or ephemeral CI environments for realistic integration and end-to-end testing.
- Hands-on performance and scalability testing experience using tools such as k6, Locust, Gatling, JMeter, or equivalent, including latency, throughput, saturation, and degradation analysis.
- Experience integrating automated test suites into GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo Workflows, or equivalent CI/CD systems, with automated quality gates and actionable reporting.
- Ability to diagnose failures across multiple services using logs, metrics, traces, database state, Kafka offsets/events, and application telemetry, rather than treating failed tests as black boxes.
- Strong understanding of test design, including integration testing, system testing, contract testing, property-based testing, regression testing, performance testing, and failure-path testing.
- Ability to independently investigate difficult intermittent and nondeterministic failures and distinguish product defects, infrastructure failures, test defects, and environmental issues.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear defect reports, test strategies, quality assessments, and release-readiness recommendations.

description:

This role is for an engineer with a solid data science/AI background who understands how models behave and is skilled in LLM evaluation, end-to-end AI testing, and ML model validation, helping us ship production-grade AI with confidence.

The Work

- Own the test strategy for our AI products, covering LLM features, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and ML models.
- Write and execute test plans, cases, and reports; manage the defect lifecycle; and perform exploratory testing of AI features.
- Define acceptance criteria and quality metrics for non-deterministic outputs (accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, relevance, cost) using LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation.

- Develop automated evaluation pipelines (DeepEval, Ragas, promptfoo, LangSmith) that run in CI/CD on every prompt, model, retrieval, or code change.

- Validate ML models and data pipelines for data quality, segment performance, bias/fairness, and drift, using statistical methods to compare versions.
- Perform adversarial and safety testing: prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII leakage, and compliance checks.
- Monitor production AI quality through observability tooling, triage degradations, lead root-cause analysis, and partner with Data Science, AI, and engineering teams on fixes and release sign-off.

The Must-Haves

- B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, ML/AI, Statistics, or related field.

- Experience evaluating GenAI applications (RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, function calling) with DeepEval, Ragas, or similar.
- Strong Python with PyTest, API testing, and CI/CD integration.
- Grounding in statistics and experimentation (sampling, significance testing, model A/B comparison), plus SQL and data validation tools such as Great Expectations or Evidently.
- Experience testing document and image analysis solutions that extract insights from unstructured data.
- Ability to define pass/fail criteria and rubrics for non-deterministic outputs and translate business requirements into measurable quality standards.
- Clear written and verbal communication with technical and business stakeholders across time zones.

The Good-to-Haves

- Synthetic test data generation, including privacy-safe datasets, edge cases, and adversarial scenarios.
- Docker, Kubernetes, and MLOps tooling for deploying and testing AI applications.
- Familiarity with AI risk and governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and responsible AI practices (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, bias testing, PII protection).
- Working knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, or similar, plus LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source models).
- UI and end-to-end test automation (Playwright, Selenium) for AI-driven interfaces.

title: QA Engineer II
description:
Overview

As the QA Engineer on the Smart Water pod, you will own quality for a product being scaled into RealPage's standard meter-operations offering, and you will do it by writing test automation rather than clicking through manual passes. You will build automated coverage for the customer-facing Smart Water experience in the Smart Building Portal, the C#/.NET services behind it, and — critically — the accuracy of the meter and usage data flowing through the ingestion pipeline.

Smart Water's history of data-integrity and onboarding defects makes this a high-impact role: you will stand up the automated regression and data-validation suites that keep calculations correct (cost, usage, loss, occupancy), run in CI on every change, and prevent the kinds of issues that have delayed customer go-lives. A core goal of the pod is to move Smart Water off manual, PME-driven QA and onto repeatable automated tests.

This role suits a QA engineer who thinks like a developer — someone who reaches for a script before a manual test case and wants to build the automation foundation for a small, fast-moving pod.

Responsibilities

 Primary Responsibilities 

- Build and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, API, data-validation) as the primary way Smart Water is tested — integrated into the Azure DevOps CI pipeline to run on every change. 
- Write automated UI and API tests across the Angular front end and C#/.NET services, replacing manual, repetitive test passes with scripted coverage. 
- Automate data-integrity checks across the ingestion pipeline — meter reads, usage, cost, loss, and occupancy calculations — so regressions are caught in CI rather than by hand. 
- Encode water-usage anomaly detection scenarios (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) as automated test cases against known data. 
- Automate verification of onboarding and self-service workflows to prevent the data and configuration defects that have historically required PMEs. 
- Partner closely with the pod's developers on quality — reproducing issues, adding regression tests, and confirming fixes. 
- Reserve exploratory/manual testing for genuinely new features, and convert what you learn there into automated coverage. 

Qualifications

This is an automation-first QA role on a C#/.NET and Angular product — the goal is scripted, CI-integrated tests, not manual QA.

- 2+ years in software QA with a strong emphasis on test automation. 
- Proven experience writing and maintaining automated tests (e.g., Selenium/Playwright/Cypress for UI, plus REST API test frameworks) — this is the core of the role. 
- Comfortable writing code/scripts to test software, not just executing manual test cases. 
- Strong SQL skills for automating data validation in MSSQL. 
- Experience integrating automated tests into a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps or similar). 
- Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required). 
- Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows — using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required). 

Preferred Required

 Preferred Skills but not required 

- Experience testing data pipelines / ETL or analytics products where data accuracy is critical. 
- Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains. 
- Experience with ElasticSearch or performance testing. 
- Familiarity with C#/.NET test tooling ( xUnit / NUnit ).

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
About Altura

Altura is an AI technology partner for companies that want technology to work inside their operation, not alongside it. We start by understanding the business. Before proposing anything, we map how the company actually runs: its processes, its systems, its data, and where the operational load sits. The goal is to find where technology has real leverage, and where it doesn't. We build the roadmap. Opportunities are prioritized by return, effort and dependencies, each one with defined scope, estimated investment, and the indicator it is meant to move. The company ends up knowing what to do first, what it costs, and how success will be measured. We implement. Custom software when existing tools don't cover what the operation needs. Automations that connect systems and remove manual work. AI agents that analyze information, decide and execute tasks within a process. And the infrastructure that makes all of it run reliably. We are not tied to a predefined solution — we choose the technology each business priority calls for. We stay after go-live. Solutions reach production and keep being improved. As the operation evolves, we identify what comes next. One team, from strategy through implementation and beyond. That is the whole point: technology projects usually break at the handoff, so we don't hand off.

Responsibilities

We need a senior QA engineer for our system with 5+ years of experience who will be able to do:
- Unit Testing- Validate individual functions and calculations.
- Test business logic and validation rules.
- Test edge cases, null values, and invalid inputs.
- Verify error handling and expected outputs.

- Integration Testing- Test frontend and backend integration.
- Verify API and database interactions.
- Test third-party integrations.
- Validate data consistency and error handling between services.

- Functional Testing- Test all features against acceptance criteria.
- Verify forms, validations, and user actions.
- Test authentication and user permissions.
- Verify successful and unsuccessful workflows.

- End-to-End (E2E) Testing- Test all critical user workflows.
- Verify data flows correctly across the application.
- Test successful and failed transactions.
- Confirm expected results and notifications.

- Regression Testing- Retest existing features after code changes.
- Run regression tests after bug fixes.
- Verify critical workflows after updates.
- Document any newly introduced defects.

- Security Testing- Test authentication and authorization.
- Verify role-based access and permissions.
- Test input validation and common vulnerabilities.
- Verify sensitive data protection and secure API access.
- Check session management and access restrictions.

- Performance Testing- Measure page load times and API response times.
- Perform load testing with expected user traffic.
- Test application behavior under peak loads.
- Identify bottlenecks and resource usage.
- Verify recovery after performance failures.

- Usability and Accessibility Testing- Review navigation and user experience.
- Verify responsive layouts and readable content.
- Test keyboard navigation and screen-reader support.
- Check accessibility against agreed WCAG criteria.
- Validate error messages and user feedback.

- Compatibility Testing- Test supported browsers and browser versions.
- Test desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
- Verify supported operating systems.
- Check responsive layouts and screen resolutions.

- User Acceptance Testing (UAT)- Validate features against business requirements.
- Execute agreed user acceptance scenarios.
- Document client feedback and requested corrections.
- Retest resolved acceptance issues.
- Obtain formal client approval.

Requirements
- 5+ years of experience in QA engineering (required)
- Comprehensive expertise across Unit, Integration, Functional, E2E, Regression, Security, Performance, Usability, Compatibility, and UAT testing (required)
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (typically expected)
- Experience working in agile environments and cross-functional teams (typically expected)

Benefits
- Competitive compensation package (to be discussed during the hiring process)
- Remote work flexibility (to be discussed during the hiring process)
- Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning (to be discussed during the hiring process)

You will work closely with engineering, product and QA teams to define test strategies, identify potential risks, improve test coverage and integrate automated testing into the software development lifecycle. **2. Test Automation (50%)**

**3. API & Integration Testing**

* Perform API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Validate backend workflows, integrations, data processing and application responses.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to investigate and resolve integration-related issues.

**4. Continuous Testing & Collaboration**

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Work within Agile development teams and actively participate in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers and other QA engineers to ensure quality throughout the SDLC.
* Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve test case generation, automation development and overall testing efficiency.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Strong practical experience in manual testing, including functional, regression, integration, exploratory and smoke testing.
* Hands-on experience with **TypeScript and Selenium WebDriver** is mandatory.
* Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks, reusable components and automated test scripts.
* Good understanding of API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, test case design, defect lifecycle and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with source code management tools such as Git/GitHub.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to modern automation frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress.
* Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling or LoadRunner.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test case generation, test automation and debugging.
* Understanding of continuous testing practices and quality engineering principles.

**Desired Competencies**
------------------------

* Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently own testing activities across manual and automation tracks.
* Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
